subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should this bundled issue remain as the umbrella tracker, or should maintainers split it into narrower canonical issues for TUI default-session routing, WeChat/plugin identity routing, sessions_send channel metadata, background-event isolation, and meaningful-activity timestamps?
rationale: The remaining symptoms span core session state, external channel-plugin ownership, TUI UX, and background-event policy, so an automated fix lane would have to guess product boundaries and risk overlapping existing open canonical issues.

options.title: Split and route by surface
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers preserve the useful evidence and move each remaining symptom to the narrow canonical issue or a new focused issue, then close the umbrella when nothing unique remains.

options.title: Keep as umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad user report and require future fix PRs to cite which sub-bug they address without closing the whole item.

options.title: Close after linking narrower items
options.body: Close this only if maintainers decide the useful evidence is fully covered by linked canonical items and a comment preserves the remaining reproduction details.

recommendation.title: Split and route by surface
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers preserve the useful evidence and move each remaining symptom to the narrow canonical issue or a new focused issue, then close the umbrella when nothing unique remains.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current routing candidate for the product split is steipete because the unresolved activity-ordering part touches the recent Sessions UI ownership and the decision is broader than one code patch.
